parameters.content:
## Reel factory: new reel
A reel is asked for from the **reel bot** (/remake, /reel) or this form. The job is saved in **dtj_reel_jobs** and the run pauses at **Wait for Claude Code: Reel**.

On DTJ's VPS the worker (n8n/store-factory/worker.py) asks in the reel bot **tap Start if you are watching**; then Claude Code makes the reel there (Codex pictures, Google Flow in the VPS Chrome, the edit). The **reel watcher** judges every step and a person approves the plan, the pictures and the final reel in Telegram. Nothing is posted to Meta.

Source in git: `n8n/reel-factory/` (deploy_reel.py), `services/reel-factory/`, skills dtj-ugc-reel and dtj-reel-watcher.

nodes.name: New UGC Reel

parameters.formDescription: One product, 1-5 winning reels to copy, the facts the reel may say. Claude makes the reel on the reel VPS while someone is on duty; nothing is posted.

values.placeholder: e.g. Senso Instant Detox Green Tea Kahwa
e.g. Gujarati home cooks 30-50, Gen Z urban India
https://... (front of the pack, label readable)

values.fieldLabel: Winning reference reels (links, one per line)
values.placeholder: https://... (mp4 or a Drive link anyone can open)

values.fieldLabel: Approved facts (only these may be said)
values.placeholder: UGC: pack text, the product page's claims, offers the client approved

values.formSubmittedText: Saved. The reel is made while someone is on duty on the reel VPS; the result is recorded in dtj_reel_jobs.

nodes.notes: The n8n form (needs an n8n login) to ask for a reel by hand: remake or UGC, product, pictures, reference reels, audience, language, facts.

nodes.name: Take the Reel Request
nodes.notes: Checks the request and makes the job row: a remake needs exactly one reference reel; a UGC reel needs a language and approved facts; every link must be https, a VPS path or a photo sent to the bot. A refusal keeps its reason.

nodes.name: From Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Where the reel bot's /remake and /reel arrive (Reel Factory: Telegram Bot): the same fields plus the person's Telegram chat.

nodes.name: Save Reel Job
nodes.notes: Saves the job in dtj_reel_jobs. Its row id is the job id in Telegram (r<id>).

nodes.name: Accepted?
nodes.notes: Only a complete request goes on; a refused one stops here, with the reason on its row.

nodes.name: Request for Claude Code: Reel
nodes.notes: Writes Claude's full task list for this reel type (remake or UGC): the VPS folders and tools, the watcher's check before each of the 3 Telegram approvals (plan, pictures, final reel), and how to answer n8n. The VPS worker reads it.

nodes.name: Wait for Claude Code: Reel
nodes.notes: Pauses (up to 3 days). The VPS worker asks 'tap Start if you are watching' in the reel bot; after the tap Claude makes the reel and answers this step with reply.py.

nodes.name: Claude Code Reply: Reel
nodes.notes: Reads Claude's answer (reel ready / needs a look / could not make, the file, length, loudness, credits used) and refuses half answers.

nodes.name: Record Reel
nodes.notes: Writes the result on the job's row in dtj_reel_jobs.

nodes.name: Tell the Requester
nodes.notes: For a reel asked in Telegram: one short message with the result and where the file is. Nothing is posted anywhere.

nodes.name: Send Result
nodes.notes: Sends that message to the requester's chat (through the reel bot once its 'DTJ Reel Bot' credential is attached).
